run_plain_text_turk_csv: run the script with tool_num 1 to generate plain text CSV for Amazon Turk annotation tasks
run_highlighted_text_turk_csv: run the script with tool_num 2 to generate CSV with highlighted words and intent for Turk tasks
run_reference_object_turk_csv: run the script with tool_num 3 to generate CSV for reference object annotation with highlighted spans
run_comparison_filters_turk_csv: run the script with tool_num 4 to generate CSV for comparison filters tool with child and ref_child columns
run_qualification_test_csv: run the script with tool_num 5 to generate qualification test CSV with three commands per row
